payload.title: Table-to-module ownership on the tenant database page is guessed by three hand-maintained maps (auth inferModuleFromTableName substring matching and two web lists) instead of MODULE_SCHEMAS, mislabelling farm departments as hr and farm tasks as project and advertising hr payrolls as a browsable table
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:1356 (a substring map: 'departments' maps to hr, 'tasks' to project, plus modules that do not exist such as crm and inventory, :1356-1380)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant-admin.service.ts:1206 (every listed table's module label comes from that guess)
web/modules/tenant-admin/src/pages/TenantDatabase.tsx:49 (first hand-maintained module-to-tables map; it lists hr payrolls at :127)
web/modules/tenant-admin/src/lib/constants.ts:64 (a second hand-maintained copy of the same table lists, including payrolls)
libs/backend-common/src/database/schema-manager.service.ts:255 (MODULE_SCHEMAS already owns the per-module table lists)
apps/farm-service/src/department/entities/department.entity.ts:79 (farm owns the table departments, which the guess labels hr)
payload.rule_violated: Repo rule of one owner per fact (MODULE_SCHEMAS owns which module a tenant table belongs to) with hierarchy impossible > automatic > detectable.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-45, release R7.
